title: Formalize the P104 endpoint-run rank and moment lower bound
body:
## Summary

Add `research/p104-endpoint-rank-lean/` and its scoped workflow. This formalizes the written matrix implication in #2662 rather than proposing another construction.

```text
actual block-matrix product
  rank B(product) <= sum of declared child charges
  rank B(product)^p <= sum of charge^p, for 0 < p <= 1

independent binary source census
  416 disjoint endpoint runs; rank mass 928
```

Five Lean theorem roots use only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The source census uses closed-form symplectic transvections and finite span sets, without importing predecessor executables. Its source-to-matrix binding remains Python evidence, not a kernel certificate.

Credit commdata2338/#2662 for the endpoint-run theorem, rewrite class and histogram; ywz65/#2586 for the physical dual; #2497/#2551, Nick Petalas/#2550 and the retained native/compiler lineage. Exact heads, byte-identical source snapshots and full credit are in the package.

## Evidence

- **Before:** #2662's matrix/concavity lower-bound implication is a written proof, with ranks checked by its retained native interpreter.
  **After:** five kernel-checked roots, four altered formal contracts rejected, and all 416 binary run ranks independently reconstructed. This corroborates the existing 928 result; it does not claim a new numerical bound.
- Six package test groups pass normally and optimized, including all 338 consumed frames, 230 small-frame cases, 256 binary matrix pairs, source/receipt corruption and a Git-free export. All 65 research-workflow tests pass. Ruff and YAML validation pass.
- Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.15, Lean 4.21.0, Mathlib `308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3`. Existing Mathlib build cache reused; no independent human review or hosted-CI success is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-endpoint-rank-lean
# After fetching the pinned formal/lean Mathlib cache:
python3.12 -Werror -B research/p104-endpoint-rank-lean/check_lean.py
```

Started from canonical main `b5ea56e0a`, priority 5. Submission refresh at `a76748640` leaves guidance and all consumed inputs unchanged; a virtual merge is conflict-free. Final overlap covered 775 open PRs and 1,333 Discussion records with complete pagination, not arbitrary diffs or unpublished work. The existing investigation is [Discussion2619](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2619).

Physical/native identification, phases, hosting, idle/residual charges, rounded erasure, precision and all-size admission remain inherited or open. No native/selected cold replay, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. The next scoped question is a kernel-checked canonical-frame and finite-rank binding.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Only an opt-in package and scoped proof workflow are added. Selected records, frozen predecessors and production verifiers are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** research
